text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — pushed a tiny follow-up to PR #1584: mostly formatting, trailing whitespace, and one var rename (ctx -> reqCtx). Planning to merge in today's 4pm batch if no objections. Diff: https://git.redwood.ai/r/1584

Eric: taking a look now. is this gofmt-only? any behavior changes?

Maya: No behavior changes, just style + rename. Here's the critical hunk:
```
- func handleRequest(ctx context.Context) error {
+ func handleRequest(reqCtx context.Context) error {
```

Joanne: small thing — import order got flipped. lint-bot complained about stdlib vs internal ordering.

lint-bot: import-order: reorder imports to put standard library first. run `goimports` or `gofmt -w` to auto-fix. (rule: import-order)

Maya: thanks — will push one more commit to fix import order and run gofmt.

Eric: cool. once import order is fixed I'm +1. prefer squash when you merge. :+1:

Sam: FYI 4pm merge window is still open — ops said no large deployments until 5pm.

Maya: pushed commit to run goimports and fix order. PTAL @Eric @Joanne

Eric: LGTM after CI passes. :thumbsup:

Joanne: looks good to me.

Maya: merging now. will monitor logs for 10m and revert if anything odd.

Maya: merged — no regressions noted in 10m smoke check. closing thread. :heavy_check_mark:
